scenes.title: Why new users never come back
scenes.say: Why do new users sign up and never come back?

scenes.title: Two first screens
scenes.say: An empty dashboard and ten menu items leave people lost. One clear task and a quick first win bring them back.

scenes.title: Fix onboarding
scenes.say: Ask one question. Show one result in the first minute. Then send one helpful nudge the next day.

scenes.title: Give users a win in minute one
scenes.say: Give every new user a win in the very first minute.
